title: Installed and outdated lists are bounded typed reads

steps.when: the script calls spinnet.tools.read for installed
steps.then: the Host runs /opt/homebrew/bin/brew info --json=v2 --installed (or /usr/local/bin/brew) with the profile environment, stdin closed, in its own process group, within 3 s, and returns projected records; on the measured Mac 838,359 bytes of Homebrew JSON became 35,308 bytes for 203 packages

steps.when: the script calls it for outdated, greedy
steps.then: brew outdated --json=v2 --greedy runs with HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1, so it never runs brew update first
a read Homebrew does not finish in 3 s fails the call with tool_timed_out after its process group is stopped; the script may catch it
